modelContextSummary: Bounded direct Logic Pro 12.3 build-6674 Channel EQ evidence on generated PCM24 fixtures at 48 and 96 kHz. At 48 kHz, settled neutral and header-bypass sweep renders reproduced the mono source PCM exactly on both interleaved output channels. Artifact-backed impulse states cover a 1 kHz +6 dB/Q1 bell, a 2.5 kHz -6 dB/Q4 bell, paired shelves, paired 24 dB/octave cuts, and one eight-band multiband shape. The exposed HQ mode measurably changed that shape; Analyzer POST/OFF/PRE and Q-Couple on/off-with-rewritten-Q comparisons nulled in their recorded states; +3 dB output measured 2.999999876 dB. Stereo, Left Only, Right Only, Mid Only, and Side Only were rendered on generated one-sided, in-phase, and anti-phase fixtures. The complex displayed state survived reload, but accepted pre/post reload groups differed by a minute -113.14 dBFS residual, so exact reload PCM is not claimed. A repeated 96 kHz complex-state render was PCM-exact and showed bounded rate-dependent response differences. Automation, exhaustive parameter grids, other channel formats/rates, musical preference, private topology, and any TrackSmith authority to control Logic remain unmeasured or prohibited.

nativeState.importantInterpretation: These are bounded directly observed Logic 12.3 states. They are not a claim about Apple's private topology, every parameter combination, or TrackSmith authority to control Logic.

input.sourceUnchangedEvidence: Every retained source copy preserves its generated suite file SHA-256; the 48 kHz suite is byte-identical to the frozen suite and the 96 kHz suite repeated byte-identically in an independent generation.

renderMethod.logicCommand: File > Bounce > Project or Section using the active cycle range
renderMethod.renderSchedulingBoundary: Logic exposed Automatic in the bounce dialog; no realtime/offline scheduling claim is made.
renderMethod.settlingRule: Preserve first-transition output, then require repeated decoded-PCM identity before making settled-state claims.
renderMethod.baselineGate: Neutral and header-bypass sweep renders had to reproduce the mono source PCM exactly on both interleaved output channels before active-state evidence was admitted.

documented_default_and_bypass_path.evidence: Neutral and header-bypass first and three settled renders were retained. Every accepted settled render broadcast the mono source PCM exactly to both output channels.

every_discrete_mode_model_algorithm_and_.evidence: Stereo, Left Only, Right Only, Mid Only, and Side Only were rendered in one complex state. Surround/dual-mono and every host channel-format variant were not run.

bounded_continuous_parameter_grid_with_i.evidence: Neutral, one broad boost, one narrow cut, paired shelves, paired 24 dB/octave pass filters, one coupled multiband state, HQ, output gain, and Q-Couple preservation were measured. A full frequency/gain/Q/slope interaction grid was not run.

reported_and_measured_latency_polarity_g.evidence: Impulse artifacts record magnitude, phase, coarse sampled group delay, pre-response, first/peak/last nonzero frames, tail duration, polarity, level, and exact frame count for every accepted impulse state at 48 kHz and one complex state at 96 kHz.

three_identical_renders_for_repeatabilit.evidence: Neutral, bypass, broad bell, and post-reload complex states have three accepted repeats where declared; shelves, multiband, stereo one-sided, output-gain, and 96 kHz states have two repeat artifacts. Accepted pairs were decoded-PCM identical.

save_reload_state_and_source_hash_verifi.evidence: The complex displayed state survived reload and three post-reload renders were internally PCM-identical. They differed from the two internally identical pre-reload renders by 1167 samples at -113.14 dBFS residual, so exact pre/post reload PCM is explicitly not claimed for the complex state. The historical simple bell state remains an independent exact-reload result.

each_band_enable_type_frequency_gain_q_a.evidence: All eight band roles participated across accepted states: low/high cuts, low/high shelves, and four peak bands. Representative frequencies, gains, Q values, and 12/24 dB-per-octave cut slopes were recorded; exhaustive parameter grids remain unknown.

single_band_and_coupled_multiband_magnit.evidence: The +6 dB/Q1 bell, -6 dB/Q4 bell, shelves, pass filters, multiband HQ-off/on states, and output-gain state have artifact-backed magnitude/phase/tail results. The frozen historical amplitude ladder remains the headroom and level-dependence evidence.

stereo_left_right_mid_side_processing_an.evidence: Left-only, right-only, in-phase, anti-phase, and frequency-split generated fixtures were retained. Channel-mode comparisons preserve channel independence, Mid/Side relationships, in-phase equality, and anti-phase mono-sum measurements without assigning perceptual value.

oversampling_output_gain_and_input_level.evidence: HQ off/on differed measurably in the complex state; +3 dB output measured 2.999999876 dB. The historical level ladder supports one bell's input-level behavior. HQ is treated only as an exposed mode label; no private oversampling topology is claimed.

analyzer_pre_post_and_display_state_audi.evidence: Analyzer POST versus OFF and POST versus PRE were decoded-PCM identical. Analyzer display state and the complex EQ values were captured before and after reload.

sampleRate.interpretation: Broad response shape was retained but exact magnitudes changed across the measured rates. Raw PCM is not compared across sample rates.

uncertainty.pcm: Integer PCM24 comparisons are exact after WAVE decode.
uncertainty.frequencyResponse: Goertzel DFT at named sampled frequencies; values describe only the finite retained impulse response and exact recorded state.
uncertainty.phase: Phase is referenced to the source impulse. Adjacent-point group delay is coarse and unreliable near deep response nulls.
uncertainty.humanListening: No controlled preference or musician-outcome listening result was collected in this run.

stateTransitionFindings.finding: First-transition renders were preserved separately and excluded from settled claims until repeated PCM identity was established.
stateTransitionFindings.consequence: Future empirical lanes must preserve transition output and prove settling rather than silently selecting a preferred render.

stateTransitionFindings.finding: The complex state reproduced internally exact PCM before and after reload, but the accepted pre-reload and post-reload groups differed by 1167 samples per channel at -113.14 dBFS residual.
stateTransitionFindings.consequence: Displayed restoration is supported; exact pre/post reload PCM is not claimed for this complex state.

stateTransitionFindings.finding: Whole-file WAVE hashes differed between several settled repeats while decoded PCM hashes were identical.
stateTransitionFindings.consequence: Decoded PCM identity is the signal-repeatability criterion while every container hash remains in the artifact ledger.

stronglySupported: The settled neutral and header-bypass states are sample-transparent for the retained 48 kHz mono sweep through both channels of the interleaved stereo bounce.
The recorded broad boost, narrow cut, shelf, pass-filter, and multiband states have bounded artifact-backed magnitude, phase, timing, and tail observations.
HQ, Q-Couple, Analyzer, output-gain, reload, five processing modes, stereo relationships, and one 96 kHz complex-state lane have direct retained evidence.
The +3 dB output control measured 2.999999876 dB in the retained complex state.
The 96 kHz repeated render is decoded-PCM identical; response differences from 48 kHz are measured state/rate observations, not raw-PCM comparisons.
inferences: The exact neutral/bypass PCM and stable finite impulse responses are consistent with deterministic behavior in these settled states, but they do not identify Apple's coefficient design or internal numeric topology.
The minute pre/post reload residual is consistent with state reconstruction or parameter quantization, but its private cause is unknown.
The exposed HQ mode materially changed the measured response in the complex state; this run does not establish that the implementation uses any specific oversampling design.
notEstablished: Apple's private filter topology, coefficient design, internal precision, or proprietary implementation.
Every frequency, gain, Q, slope, interaction, channel format, sample rate, automation path, smoothing law, or transition behavior.
Controlled musical preference, genre-specific superiority, universal usefulness, or a preferred Channel EQ strategy.
TrackSmith authority to inspect, insert, reorder, automate, control, or save Logic-native processors.
